Workshop Sequence · Step-by-Step Order

How Artists Made Paint Before Painting (Tap Hear on any step)

Put the steps in order from 1 to 5: buy powder, grind fine, add oil, mix paint, and paint.
Past Habits · "Used To + Base Verb"

How People Lived Back Then (Tap any card to listen)

Use used to for habits in the past that are no longer true today.

Practice: Complete Each Sentence with "used to"

Write used to + base verb (for example: used to get, used to read).
Personal Writing · Guided Frame & Open Sentences

How You Used To Live (Before Moving or When You Were a Child)

Part 1: Writing Frames (Finish Each Sentence)

Complete each sentence after the pronoun using used to or didn't for a negative sentence.

Part 2: Open Writing (Write Your Own Sentences)

Write 3 full sentences of your own about how you used to live, travel, eat, or spend time in your previous country or as a child.

Tip: After used to or didn't use to, use the base verb (for example: used to live, used to walk).

One Person or Thing
There is + [a / an + noun] + [verb + -ing]

Example: There is a skeleton holding an hourglass.

Two or More People or Things
There are + [plural noun] + [verb + -ing]

Example: There are ships burning out at sea.
